summary: Unlock the secrets of sales psychology and buyer motivation. Enroll in our comprehensive course to enhance your sales skills and drive conversions effectively.
lede: Sales psychology training helps professionals who influence buyer decisions understand what motivates people to buy. It supports the practical work of uncovering real needs, reading buying signals, and matching value messages to buyers’ priorities. Participants practise building trust, adapting communication to different decision styles, handling objections, and using ethical persuasion in pricing, negotiation, and closing conversations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence buyer decisions and must understand buyer motivation.
modules: Building Trust Fast in Sales Conversations
Discovery That Uncovers the Real Problem
Pricing, Perceived Value, and Buyer Resistance
Buyer Journey Mapping and Messaging Alignment
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites, but a basic understanding of sales processes is beneficial.
